description: Foundation and authentication system: project structure, configuration, database schema with UTC timezone, SQLAlchemy models using schema-first strategy (no Python defaults for MySQL-managed columns per FINDING #1), Flask app factory with READ COMMITTED isolation (FINDING #6), user authentication with type-safe User.get_id() (FINDING #3), role-based access control, login/logout routes, base templates with Bootstrap 5 UI framework
steps: Create complete directory structure: app/ with __init__.py, models.py, forms.py, utils.py, auth.py; app/routes/ with __init__.py, auth.py, admin.py, employee.py; app/templates/ with base.html, login.html, admin/, employee/, errors/ subdirs; app/static/ with css/style.css, js/main.js, uploads/ subdir

Create config.py with Config base class (SECRET_KEY from env, DATABASE_URI mysql+pymysql, SQLALCHEMY_ENGINE_OPTIONS with isolation_level='READ COMMITTED', pool_pre_ping, pool_size 10, max_overflow 20, UPLOAD_FOLDER, MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH 10MB, WTF_CSRF_ENABLED, session security), DevelopmentConfig (DEBUG=True), ProductionConfig (DEBUG=False, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE)

Create requirements.txt with exact versions: Flask==2.3.3, SQLAlchemy==2.0.20, Flask-Login==0.6.2, Flask-WTF==1.1.1, Flask-Bcrypt==1.0.1, PyMySQL==1.1.0, pandas==2.1.0, openpyxl==3.1.2, Werkzeug==2.3.7, python-dotenv==1.0.0
Create .env.example with FLASK_APP=run.py, FLASK_ENV=development, SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL placeholders
Create run.py that imports create_app and runs app

Create schema.sql: add SET time_zone = '+00:00' at top (FINDING #5); define employees table (emp_id VARCHAR(20) PK, name, email UNIQUE, department, designation, manager_id self-FK, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, created_at/updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); users table (user_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PK, username UNIQUE, password_hash, role ENUM('admin','employee'), emp_id FK, is_active, created_at/updated_at); tas_records table (tas_id PK, tas_number VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE, emp_id FK, travel_from, travel_to, travel_date_start/end DATE, purpose TEXT, estimated_cost DECIMAL(10,2), status ENUM('Pending','Approved','Rejected') DEFAULT 'Pending', submitted_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by FK users, rejection_reason TEXT, created_at/updated_at); tas_sequence table (emp_id PK FK, last_sequence INT DEFAULT 0); all indexes; seed admin user with bcrypt hash for password 'admin123'

In app/__init__.py, create Flask app factory create_app(config_name): load config from config dict, ensure UPLOAD_FOLDER exists, warn if templates/static missing, initialize db/login_manager/csrf/bcrypt extensions, register RequestEntityTooLarge error handler, configure Flask-Login user_loader with try/except (ValueError, TypeError) returning None (FINDING #3), set login_view='auth.login'

In app/models.py, define db, bcrypt instances; Employee model with emp_id PK, name, email, department, designation, manager_id self-FK, is_active, created_at, updated_at (NO default/onupdate - schema handles it per FINDING #1), relationships to tas_records and user

In app/models.py, User model with UserMixin, user_id PK, username, password_hash, role SQLAEnum('admin','employee', native_enum=True), emp_id FK, is_active, created_at, updated_at (NO defaults); methods: set_password(password) validates min 8 chars raises ValueError, check_password(password), get_id() validates self.user_id is not None then returns str(self.user_id) (FINDING #3)

In app/models.py, TASRecord model with tas_id PK, tas_number UNIQUE, emp_id FK, travel_from, travel_to, travel_date_start, travel_date_end, purpose, estimated_cost Numeric(10,2), status SQLAEnum('Pending','Approved','Rejected', native_enum=True), submitted_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by FK, rejection_reason (NO defaults)
In app/models.py, TASSequence model with emp_id PK FK, last_sequence Integer (NO default)
In app/auth.py, implement @admin_required decorator: check current_user.is_authenticated AND current_user.is_active AND current_user.role == 'admin' else abort(403)
In app/auth.py, implement @employee_required decorator: check current_user.is_authenticated AND current_user.is_active AND current_user.role == 'employee' else abort(403)
In app/forms.py, create LoginForm with username (DataRequired), password (DataRequired), submit fields

In app/routes/auth.py, create auth_bp blueprint; implement GET /login: if current_user.is_authenticated redirect to role-based dashboard (admin→/admin/dashboard, employee→/employee/dashboard), else render login.html

In app/routes/auth.py, implement POST /login: validate form, query user by username, check user exists and check_password, if is_active False flash 'Account is inactive. Contact administrator.' and do NOT call login_user, if valid call login_user and redirect to role-based dashboard, if invalid flash 'Invalid username or password'
In app/routes/auth.py, implement GET /logout: call logout_user and redirect to /login

In app/templates/base.html, create base template with Bootstrap 5.3 CDN, jQuery 3.7, DataTables 1.13, Chart.js 4.x CDN; structure: top nav bar (blue #4F46E5, logo, search, user profile dropdown with logout), left sidebar (240px, light bg #F9FAFB, menu items with active state), main content area with {% block content %}, flash message handling (error→alert-danger, success/warning/info direct map), footer; load /static/css/style.css and /static/js/main.js

In app/templates/login.html, create login page extending base.html: centered card with login form (username, password, submit button), Bootstrap styling, flash messages display, form renders {{ form.hidden_tag() }} for CSRF

In app/static/css/style.css, define CSS variables: --primary-blue: #4F46E5, --success-green: #10B981, --warning-orange: #F59E0B, --info-purple: #A855F7, --danger-red: #EF4444, --bg-light: #F9FAFB, --bg-white: #FFFFFF, --card-purple: #E9D5FF, --card-green: #D1FAE5, --card-blue: #DBEAFE, --card-peach: #FED7AA, --text-primary: #111827, --text-secondary: #6B7280, --border-light: #E5E7EB, --shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); style sidebar, nav, responsive layout (sidebar collapse to hamburger < 768px)
In app/static/js/main.js, create empty file with comment placeholder for DataTables and Chart.js initialization (added in later features)
In run.py, import create_app, call app = create_app(), run app.run(debug=True) if __name__ == '__main__'
Register auth_bp blueprint in app/__init__.py create_app function with app.register_blueprint(auth_bp)

Create README.md with: project overview, prerequisites (Python 3.9+, MySQL 8.0+), setup instructions (virtualenv, pip install, .env config, database creation, schema.sql execution with timezone verification SELECT @@session.time_zone), run instructions (flask run), admin default credentials (admin/admin123), verification steps, cleanup_old_exports() cron note
